brief: A small-parts organizer with at least six separate bins.

requirements.evidence: Hexagonal flower of 7 full-depth bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full plus 6x hex-bin-full-div2 around it), dressed with M3 screws/nuts/standoffs heaps to show small-parts use, visible from above (look polar 10).
7 bin parts placed; the 6 divided bins each have 2 compartments, giving 13 separate compartments in total (>=6 bins by either count). check_build ok, meshClash clear, one connected group.

finish.summary: Built a 7-cell hexagonal small-parts organizer: one plain full-depth center bin ringed by six 2-compartment full-depth bins (13 separate compartments, well over six bins), with open faces capped and joints locked, staged with M3 screws, nuts and standoffs. check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
